pairs: And having called together his twelve disciples,
he gave them authority over unclean spirits,
Duodecim autem Apostolorum nomina sunt hæc.
Now the names of the twelve Apostles are these:
“Do not travel by the way of the Gentiles,
et in civitates Samaritanorum ne intraveritis:
and do not enter into the city of the Samaritans,
sed potius ite ad oves quæ perierunt domus Israël.
but instead go to the sheep who have fallen away from the house of Israel.
saying: ‘For the kingdom of heaven has drawn near.’
Do not choose to possess gold,
dignus enim est operarius cibo suo.
For the laborer deserves his portion.
In quamcumque autem civitatem aut castellum intraveritis,
into whatever city or town you will enter,
inquire as to who is worthy within it.
And stay there until you depart.
Then, when you enter into the house,
Et siquidem fuerit domus illa digna,
And if, indeed, that house is worthy,
your peace will rest upon it.
But if it is not worthy,
your peace will return to you.
And whoever has neither received you,
shake off the dust from your feet.
Tolerabilius erit terræ Sodomorum et Gomorrhæorum in die judicii,
it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment,
Ecce ego mitto vos sicut oves in medio luporum.
Behold, I am sending you like sheep in the midst of wolves.
Estote ergo prudentes sicut serpentes, et simplices sicut columbæ.
Therefore, be as prudent as serpents and as simple as doves.
For they will hand you over to councils,
et in synagogis suis flagellabunt vos:
and they will scourge you in their synagogues.
et ad præsides, et ad reges ducemini propter me in testimonium illis, et gentibus.
And you shall be led before both rulers and kings for my sake, as a testimony to them and to the Gentiles.
But when they hand you over,
nolite cogitare quomodo, aut quid loquamini:
do not choose to think about how or what to speak.
dabitur enim vobis in illa hora, quid loquamini:
For what to speak shall be given to you in that hour.
non enim vos estis qui loquimini,
For it is not you who will be speaking,
but the Spirit of your Father,
Tradet autem frater fratrem in mortem,
And brother will hand over brother to death,
and father will hand over son.
And children will rise up against parents
et eritis odio omnibus propter nomen meum:
And you will be hated by all for the sake of my name.
qui autem perseveraverit usque in finem,
But whoever will have persevered, even to the end,
Cum autem persequentur vos in civitate ista,
Now when they persecute you in one city,
you will not have exhausted all the cities of Israel,
before the Son of man returns.
The disciple is not above the teacher,
nor is the servant above his master.
sufficit discipulo ut sit sicut magister ejus,
It is sufficient for the disciple that he be like his teacher,
and the servant, like his master.
If they have called the Father of the family, ‘Beelzebub,’
how much more those of his household?
Nihil enim est opertum, quod non revelabitur:
For nothing is covered that shall not be revealed,
nor hidden that shall not be known.
What I tell you in darkness,
And what you hear whispered in the ear,
Et nolite timere eos qui occidunt corpus,
And do not be afraid of those who kill the body,
but are not able to kill the soul.
But instead fear him who is able to destroy both soul
qui potest et animam et corpus perdere in gehennam.
Are not two sparrows sold for one small coin?
et unus ex illis non cadet super terram sine Patre vestro.
And yet not one of them will fall to the ground without your Father.
Vestri autem capilli capitis omnes numerati sunt.
For even the hairs of your head have all been numbered.
You are worth more than many sparrows.
Omnis ergo qui confitebitur me coram hominibus,
everyone who acknowledges me before men,
et ego eum coram Patre meo,
I also will acknowledge before my Father,
Qui autem negaverit me coram hominibus,
But whoever will have denied me before men,
negabo et ego eum coram Patre meo,
I also will deny before my Father,
Nolite arbitrari quia pacem venerim mittere in terram:
Do not think that I came to send peace upon the earth.
I came, not to send peace,
veni enim separare hominem adversus patrem suum,
For I came to divide a man against his father,
and a daughter against her mother,
and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
And the enemies of a man will be those of his own household.
Qui amat patrem aut matrem plus quam me,
or mother more than me is not worthy of me.
et qui amat filium aut filiam super me,
or daughter above me is not worthy of me.
Et qui non accipit crucem suam, et sequitur me, non est me dignus.
And whoever does not take up his cross and follow me is not worthy of me.
et qui perdiderit animam suam propter me,
And whoever will have lost his life because of me,
Qui recipit prophetam in nomine prophetæ,
in the name of a prophet,
et qui recipit justum in nomine justi,
shall receive the reward of a prophet.
And whoever receives the just in the name of the just shall receive the reward of the just.
Et quicumque potum dederit uni ex minimis istis calicem aquæ frigidæ tantum in nomine discipuli: amen dico vobis, non perdet mercedem suam.
And whoever shall give, even to one of the least of these, a cup of cold water to drink, solely in the name of a disciple: Amen I say to you, he shall not lose his reward.”
